text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Representative Exchange 
Race— The results of this race will decide 
this year's Japanese team members.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This will be the stage to unleash all the 
effort she's built up until now, along 
with her deep-seated passion for the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With all of Japan watching with bated 
breath, the 4th match of the 
Representative Exchange Races begins...!
